title: ロボット基礎力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics II
keywords: Laws of conservation of momentum and angular momentum
educationalGoal: In "Engineering Mechanics I," students mainly studied statics such as the balance of forces acting on masses and rigid bodies. In this course, students understand the dynamic relationship between external force and momentum, torque and angular momentum acting on system of particles, and learn basic analytical methods for collision problems and dynamics such as force impulse, moment of inertia and rotational motion of a rigid body.
advice:
For studying mechanics, it is important to solve a variety of mechanical problems independently in addition to understanding the meaning of terms and mathematical formulas.
In this course, the following basic mechanics topics are covered:
1. Equation of motion of a mass system
2. Motion of the center of gravity and system of particles
3. Collision mechanics and force impulse
4. Momentum, angular momentum, and kinetic energy
5. Moment of inertia
6. Rigid body motion
requiredKnowledge: Mathematics for basic engineering (description of equations of motion and derivatives / integrals, inner and outer products of vectors) and "Engineering Mechanics I".

activityGoals.body: Explain the motion around the center of gravity of a mass system.
Explain the collision phenomenon using the law of conservation of momentum.
Understand the relationship between angular momentum and moment of force.
Explain the motion of a mass system and rigid body using the law of conservation of angular momentum.
Calculate the center of gravity and moment of inertia of objects with simple shapes.
Explain the dynamic behavior of a rigid body using the equation of motion.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1.Calculate the moment of inertia of various machine models from the definition of moment of inertia.
2.Derive equations of motion for various machine models and solve them so as to explain the dynamic behavior of machine models.
3.Analyze various collision phenomena using the momentum conservation law.
4.Explain the dynamic behavior of various machine models using the law of conservation of angular momentum.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. Calculate the moment of inertia of an object consisting of a combination of basic form.
2. Describe the equations related to motion for the center of gravity of mass systems.
3. Derive the velocity after the centripetal collision of two bodies on a straight line by using the conservation of momentum.
4. Describe the equations related to rotation and plane motion of rigid bodies.

              In "Engineering Mechanics I," students mainly studied statics such as the balance of forces acting on masses and rigid bodies. In this course, students understand the dynamic relationship between external force and momentum, torque and angular momentum acting on system of particles, and learn basic analytical methods for collision problems and dynamics such as force impulse, moment of inertia and rotational motion of a rigid body.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              For studying mechanics, it is important to solve a variety of mechanical problems independently in addition to understanding the meaning of terms and mathematical formulas.
In this course, the following basic mechanics topics are covered:
1. Equation of motion of a mass system
2. Motion of the center of gravity and system of particles
3. Collision mechanics and force impulse
4. Momentum, angular momentum, and kinetic energy
5. Moment of inertia
6. Rigid body motion
